name: office

Provides office:email, office:calendar, office:jira, office:github, office:archive, office:organize, office:log-analyzer, office:personal-email, office:personal-calendar, office:slack, office:pulse, office:morning-brief, office:testrail, office:csv-analysis, and office:image-optimize skills.
